embed.title: !community (admin)
embed.description: Manage which area-security communities users and channels belong to. A community decides which areas its members can select and where their alerts can come from. Only matters when `[area_security]` is enabled.

fields.name: View
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}community list` — the configured communities
`{{prefix}}community` — your own memberships (in a registered channel: the channel's)
`{{prefix}}community show <id> <id>` — memberships and location restrictions of others

fields.name: Change
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}community add london <id>` — add to the "london" community
`{{prefix}}community remove london <id>` — remove from it
`{{prefix}}community clear <id>` — remove from every community

Write community names as `{{prefix}}community list` shows them. Give several IDs to change several at once{{#if isDiscord}}; @mentions work too{{/if}}. Use bare IDs: `user:<id>` and `channel:<id>` don't work here. For a webhook, add `name:<webhookname>` instead of an ID.

Without an ID, these change the channel you run them in (if it's registered). In a DM they won't change you; the reply shows the command to use instead.

fields.name: Automatic sync
fields.value: Membership is normally set from Discord roles and Telegram group membership by the reconciliation settings in config.toml. Where that sync is on, the next run puts members back to match their roles or groups, so use this command for webhooks and channels, or where sync is off.
